rationale: The regression is now reproduced twice, so the remaining way it could be wrong is causal: perhaps the instrumented store's held-open write loses the term by itself, and the off-main-thread heartbeat only happens to be present in the two runs. That is exactly the competing explanation a control can settle, and it is cheap because the scenario is already built. This turn queues the control: the same single node, the same instrumented store, the same deposition and the same held-open election write, with one thing missing - the empty heartbeat delivered on the fast path during the hold. If the term after release is still higher than the term that was held (3 to 4), the held write is monotone on its own and the regression in the witness runs is attributable to the off-thread write; if the term fell without that heartbeat, the regression belongs to the instrumentation and the witness account would have to be withdrawn. I record the refined discriminator on the same investigation rather than opening a new one, since this is the same cause and the same responsibility, and I assert nothing until the control's receipt exists.

investigations.discriminator: Hold the main loop's term write open by supplying a stable store whose write of the current term can be armed to block once, deliver one empty heartbeat with a term well above the current one on the fast path while it is held, then release and read both the in-memory term and the persisted term: a term after release lower than the term adopted during the hold witnesses a durable term regression caused by the off-thread write. Executed twice with the same operands (CheckRuns d5d2d6e4b4304f65ba05d1869b42fa3c and f5bfa53fce5c4314a29fe898c38b8808). A control is now queued that repeats the same held-open election with no heartbeat delivered during the hold: if the term after release is still higher than the held term, the held write is monotone by itself and the regression is attributable to the off-thread write, while a fall without the heartbeat would show the regression belongs to the instrumentation and the witness account would be withdrawn.

knowledge.assertion: the candidate path reads the current term, computes the next one and writes it through setCurrentTerm with no guard around the pair, so a higher term written off the main thread in between is overwritten in memory and in the stable store
in two independent executions the fast-path heartbeat's term was adopted in memory and in the stable store and then the node's term and persisted term fell below it after the held write landed

scope.description: Control for the term-regression witness: on the same single-node setup with the same instrumented store, hold the election's term write open and release it without delivering any heartbeat, then emit one CA_EVENT JSON line recording the term and persisted term before the hold, while it is held, and after release, together with the node's state.
assumptions: The setup is identical to the witness harness - in-memory transport wrapped for the heartbeat fast path, instrumented stable store, single-voter bootstrap, a real empty heartbeat to depose the node - so the only difference is the absence of the heartbeat delivered during the hold.
The instrumented store still holds only the first write of the current term after being armed, so the released write is the election's own.

If the held write alone produced a fall in the term, the discrimination would fail and the witness account would be withdrawn; the control is therefore a genuine test of the account rather than a supporting demonstration.

experiment.prefix: The harness (draft/assurance_generated_test.go) is one TestAssurance-prefixed control test plus the local transport wrapper and store wrapper used by the witness. It creates the in-memory transport, wraps it for the heartbeat fast path, wraps the in-memory store so its next write of the current term can be held open, bootstraps a single-voter configuration with BootstrapCluster and starts the node with NewRaft, then waits (bounded) for Leader state. It records the term as leader and delivers an empty heartbeat one term above it, which is a real depose, then arms the store and waits (bounded) for the gate to be entered, recording the term and state at that moment and the persisted term while the write is held. It then releases the gate without delivering anything else, waits briefly, and records the term, the persisted term and the state again, printing one CA_EVENT JSON line tagged term_control_no_heartbeat with all operands, and shuts the node down.
